programme.sub-title: La cárcel de mis sueños / Estafa en el volcán

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natasha inventó en Internet una historia de violencia de su marido contra ella. En otro caso, Claribel quiere que su hija desaloje la casa, pues María acusó de abuso sexual a su papá.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ania y Jaime se separaron porque él se obsesionó con el juego. También, Linda e Ismael tienen un hogar de ancianos, pero ella no está de acuerdo con algunas prácticas de él.
programme.sub-title: Por un raspadito / Orina para larga vida

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: La cara de la vida / Vajilla familiar

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Desde que Patricia tiene una relación de noviazgo con otro trabajador, Miriam le ha dado un ultimátum. Bryan se comió el plato de exposición de un restaurante, la dueña tomó acciones.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gerber le dio un batazo brutal en la cabeza a su cuñado porque le daba drogas a su mujer. Además, Sergio era un narco que se casó con Jéssica y con Miriam el mismo día.
programme.sub-title: Dealer en coma / Princesas de la mafia

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Micaela, en defensa de su mamá, le lanza una cafetera a su papá y lo mata. Por otro lado, el amante de María, en un encuentro de placer, le hace un hematoma en el cuello que se complica.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Justin is the low man on the totem pole in the Chapman clan, and this means that the rest of the team is always teasing him. But Justin wants to be a full-fledged member of the team, and Dog has a fugitive that will be his test case.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources--the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond. Then Brandon's mother decides to revoke his bond because Brandon has an ice habit.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: A fugitive from justice is on the lam, and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address, they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address. The posse's one hope is to locate his girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Kimo does a vanishing act for his day in court, and now Dog and the posse have to find him. With precious few leads to follow, Dog turns to the fugitive's on again-off-again girlfriend, but she's initially reluctant to join the hunt.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in, it's a tough job, but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog tracks a fugitive who is on the run from the law for the first time. Reading the file Dog knows the young man's life is at the crossroads. Will he be able to track down this wanna-be-gansta in time to convince him to make the right choice?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Facing hard time for forging checks, Melissa pulled a vanishing act at her sentencing hearing, bolting from the courthouse in broad daylight. Lucky for her, bondsman Dog and his posse are in Colorado and ready to help.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today's case is a twofer, a brother and sister both charged with drug related offenses. Also, Dog has crossed paths with the brother before. He once tried to stop Dog from arresting one of the most violent fugitives of his career.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: A Hawaiian surfing hero is on a wave to nowhere, and it's Dog's turn to play lifeguard. "Buttons," known throughout the islands for his prowess on the waves and his daring 360's, has wiped-out on the rocky shoals of drug addiction.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is a rough, tough bounty hunter, but he's a softie at heart, as the two cases in this episode show.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog takes the day off to try his hand at coaching, and assigns Tim and Leland to track down a dangerous fugitive on their own. Can the boys prove they can handle it?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With twelve kids of his own, Dog knows how hard it is to keep children on the straight and narrow, especially during their turbulent teens.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog knows very little about Peter, but what he does know, he doesn't like! Not only is he currently facing two counts of second degree sexual assault, about week ago, he dropped out of sight before missing his court date.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Roger has 27 prior arrests, spent years in jail and doesn't want to go back. But he's missed court and now Dog has to bring him in. To complicate matters, this fugitive lives in a tightly-knit community, where good information won't come easy.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter: Baby's Back in Town
programme.desc: Dog tries to nab a fugitive, named Wayne, by calling and telling him that he's won a new vacuum cleaner and he should stick around to get it. Dog then sends his daughter, Lyssa, to "deliver" the vacuum cleaner and lure Wayne out of his house.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold, it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When Lyssa points out that the fugitive in the next case has the same birth date as Barbara, Dog's recently deceased daughter, the team takes a special vow to capture the young woman.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With the aid of the runner's girlfriend, the posse heads out to bring a client with a checkered past in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day, Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog pursues two people whose lives have been ruined by drugs. First, he tracks Mae, who traded a good home and loving family for an ice pipe. The next case involves Jude. His addiction has caused his pregnant wife to fear for her safety.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Kristine had a string of gambling and forgery charges before she jumped bail, leaving Dog "holding the bag". Now it's time for Dog to call in some chits of his own, getting the help of trusty informants he's helped out over the years

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: It hurts Dog to see people who?after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog kick-starts the search for Jackson, a 240lbs, six feet tall bad boy who has skipped out on a $10,000 bond. Jackson’s apparently at his father-in-law's house, but the father-in-law has info about Jackson that brings Dog to a unique hideout.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Going after two fugitives in one day is tough enough without the facing Colorado's notoriously unpredictable weather. Today it's the threat of severe thunderstorm, hail and area wide tornado warnings.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: James Toney vs Mike McCallum 3

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the peaceful village of Little Worthy, Bob Moss was about to open up his beloved model village, when he found a gruesome extra attraction. Barnaby and Jones wonder who wanted him dead, but when the woman he was secretly meeting is killed during the village's Crazy Craft race, the pair have to delve in and discover who might be lying and hiding secrets.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A cat burglar is on the loose, one known as "the Creeper", but the wave of burglaries he or she have committed, seem to have finally led to murder, when David Roper (Rik Mayall) is found smothered in his bed on the Chettham family estate. Yet Barnaby and Jones learn he may have been planning to write a book that could have been quite uncomfortable for someone, leading the pair to determine whether members of the Chettham family, or their friends, were responsible.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A sleep-walking school teacher (Nancy Carroll) starts to believe she has slit the throats of her mentor (Tim Wylton) and a local handyman man in her sleep, but her friends (Paola Dionisotti and Monica Dolan) are not convinced that she is the culprit, nor is Barnaby. A local philanthropist (Paul Chapman) and his social-climbing wife (Suzanne Burden) are planning the annual Frobisher night - but will it go without a hitch, and can they identify the killer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby arrives in Midsomer and is bemused by the quaint villages and their quirky residents. But when a local DJ is crushed to death at a traditional girls' boarding school, he soon discovers that murder and deception are never far away. As the death toll rises, could Barnaby's first case also be his last?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The reclusive lives of elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham (Edward Fox and Phyllida Law) comes under police scrutiny when a social services investigator (Jeff Rawle) is murdered. Barnaby and Jones must unearth generations of family secrets and decipher astronomical charts to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young woman is dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. With the serial killer still at large, could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Jones goes undercover at the Oblong Foundation after one of the cult's young female members disappears suddenly. But he and Barnaby soon start digging into an old case involving the death of a couple in a boat explosion.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In Midsomer Mow, the gruesome discovery of a farmer's eviscerated body in an ancient stone circle is made just days before the spring equinox.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A VAT inspector goes missing as he hunts for an illicit cider still responsible for brewing The Beast, a potent local hooch. At the Midsomer Abbas spring fayre which celebrates its friendship with Midsomer Herne, Barnaby and Jones sample the local cider, while temperance preacher Norman Grigor calls on residents to repent of their drunken ways. Suddenly, Barnaby is violently ill as the body of missing man Peter Slim is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile Samuel Quested (Warren Clarke), the traditionalist mayor of Midsomer Abbas, seeks to revive the ancient rite known as 'The Stag'.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate the cloistered world of Midsomer Priory when a nun is strangled to death. The detectives uncover a complex mystery involving holy orders, teenage romantic liaisons, African art and missing antique silver as the community is forced to open its doors to 21st-century policing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When DCI Barnaby and DS Troy arrive in the sleepy village of Badger's Drift to investigate the sudden death of elderly Miss Emily Simpson, her next door neighbour insists that she had been murdered, after she had seen her return from a walk in the woods, unnerved and shocked by something she had witnessed. When the post mortem confirms her death was no accident, the pair discover that nothing is what it seems to be within the little village as they try to find out what exactly she saw. Their investigation introduces Barnaby and Troy to many eccentric and quirky residents and soon turns up a web of sex, blackmail and lies, and the possibility that the murder could be connected to a shooting accident two years ago, which claimed another woman's life.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: After debating on who their next guest speaker should be, the Midsomer Worthy Writers' Circle decide to invite famous writer, Max Jennings, to their next meeting, despite opposition to the choice by Gerald Hadleigh, the group's chairman. When Hadleigh is found dead the day after Jennings visit, brutally bludgeoned and stripped naked, Barnaby and Troy discover that the victim had many mysteries to him, prompting them to delve into his private life and his past. Matters soon become complicated when Jennings disappears and is later found dead, and a witness recalls seeing a mysterious woman in Hadleigh's house the night before his murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst investigating the murder of Agnes Gray, a quiet animal-loving woman who was bludgeoned to death and found floating in a river near to the village of Ferne Basset, Barnaby gets more than he bargained for when he attends his wife's performance in the Causton Amateur Dramatics' production of Amadeus. When Agnes's cousin, Esslyn Carmichael, inadvertently cuts his own throat during the final act, it's quickly discovered that the tape on the prop blade he had used was removed without anyone knowing. The detective is left wondering who had wanted to turn Esslyn's final act into a true coup de theatre, as he and Troy try to determine what the motive was behind the two murders.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Local villagers in Morton Fendle are up in arms, demanding answers from Alan Hollingsworth, the owner of a local craft centre they had invested in, after news comes out that it has recently fallen into financial turmoil. As tensions begin rising in the village, Barnaby soon suspects that something has happened to Alan's wife, Simone, when his behaviour suddenly changes. His suspicions are soon confirmed when it transpires that Simone was kidnapped, after one of Alan's neighbours is murdered, shortly after witnessing something they shouldn't have.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Bill Carter, one of the founders of a local New Age commune called the Lodge of the Golden Windhorse, dies suddenly after falling down some stairs and breaking his neck. Although there was uncertainty as to whether it was the result of an accident or murder, Barnaby and Troy find themselves having to determine which it was, when Ian Craigie, the commune's leader, is stabbed to death with a carving knife a few days later, while attending a spiritual seance with the rest of the commune and the parents of one of its members. It's not long before they discover hidden truths about the commune's founding and some of its members.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The closing of what was once a very popular public garden in Midsomer Deverell sparks a series of murders that have Inspector Barnaby and Sgt. Troy stumped.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the funeral of local hotelier Karl Wainwright, his hotel's manager and a well liked Punch and Judy performer, Gregory Chambers, disappears unusually in yet another picturesque Midsomer village. Most people dismiss his disappearance completely but when he doesn't turn up, a search is conducted and a severed hand, confirmed to be Gregory's, turns up in the woods. Further deaths and a mushroom poisoning occur surrounding the beneficiaries of Karl Wainwright's will. All is not as it seems.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A man's naked body found under mysterious circumstances, within a crop circle on Sir Harry Chatwyn's wheat field, leads police to investigating how he wound up in the field after being electrocuted. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.1
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Hoy He Soñado con Dios
programme.desc: Una mujer tiene tres hijos muy diferentes: una hija fracasada, el otro un boxeador furtivo y su hijo el sacerdote.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Milagro en el Barrio
programme.desc: Un niño ciego y el hijo de una rica familia se hacen amigos aún en contra de la voluntad de la madre del último.

programme.title: El Llanto de los Pobres
programme.desc: Un joven ilegal es acusado por un robo que no cometió, purga una condena en la cárcel donde sueña con volver a su país.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Fútbol de alcoba
programme.desc: Un equipo de fútbol femenino se dirige a la capital para competir. Para reforzarlo, el entrenador se viste de mujer.

programme.title: Secuestro
programme.desc: Urgido de dinero, un publicista (Richard Grieco) se suma a los planes de un secuestrador (Michele Greene).

programme.title: El Placer de la Venganza
programme.desc: Una doctora y su familia son agredidos durante un robo, y después se encuentra a un joven que tomó parte en el ataque.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Yo fui novio de Rosita Alvírez
programme.desc: Un charro se emborracha y llora al recordar a su novia, una coqueta mujer que terminó muerta en manos de uno de sus pretendientes.

programme.title: Arsenio Lupin
programme.desc: Un millonario contrata a Sherlock Holmes para que atrape a Arsenio Lupin, un ladrón elegante que roba a los ricos para repartir los botines que consigue entre los pobres.

programme.title: El que con niños se acuesta
programme.desc: Un mensajero de telégrafos es rechazado por los padres de su novia y ambos deciden escapar juntos a la capital.

programme.title: El hombre sin rostro
programme.desc: Un médico legista desea renunciar a su trabajo en el Departamento de Policía porque lo atemoriza un asesino de prostitutas y, finalmente, le pide ayuda a un colega.

programme.title: Dicen Que Soy Hombre Malo
programme.desc: Un cacique prohíbe casarse a su sobrina para quedarse con la fortuna que dejó su hermano fallecido para ella.

programme.title: Horas de Agonía
programme.desc: Una mujer sale de un sanatorio psiquiátrico y seduce a varios hombres a quienes manipula a su antojo.

programme.title: Mi adorada Clementina
programme.desc: Un hombre quiere divorciarse de su esposa porque él es moderno y ella fue educada a la antigua por su abuelo.

programme.title: En Este Mundo en que Vivimos: Los Fernández de Peralvillo
programme.desc: Un joven fracasa como vendedor de artículos domésticos y su hermana cansada de la pobreza se fuga con un delincuente.

programme.title: Agarrando parejo
programme.desc: Dos ricas herederas les dicen a sus abuelos que están casadas para evitar bodas arregladas, pero todo se complica cuando ellos quieren conocer a los esposos.

programme.title: Misterios de la magia negra
programme.desc: Un profesor quiere investigar los misterios de la magia negra, y empieza a vivir extraños sucesos a su alrededor.

programme.title: Los viejos somos así
programme.desc: Una joven presta dinero de su trabajo a su novio y este no se lo paga, pero un anciano la ayuda a cambio de amor.

programme.title: Juan Charrasqueado
programme.desc: Un ranchero regresa a su pueblo, les gana en un juego de cartas a unos jugadores profesionales y escapa con su novia.

programme.title: Aventuras de Joselito y Pulgarcito
programme.desc: Un niño español se embarca rumbo a México para buscar a su padre y se hace amigo de un niño vendedor de periódicos.

programme.title: María Cristina
programme.desc: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y para ayudar dice que es suyo, pero el patrón descubre todo.

programme.title: Hay ángeles con espuelas
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego, que todos pensaban muerto, regresa para visitar a su abuela con una gran sorpresa.

programme.title: La vendedora de amor
programme.desc: La historia de una mujer que entrega amor por dinero, pero pronto descubre que fue un error y que ya no podrá arreglarlo.

programme.title: Bala de Plata en el pueblo maldito
programme.desc: Un joven es herido y pierde su caballo, cuando sana reclama una mina hallada por su padre y recupera a su animal.

programme.title: Cabaret Shangai
programme.desc: Un gánster es el propietario de un cabaret donde trabaja una cantante que, a la vez, es su amante.

programme.title: Los Cinco Halcones
programme.desc: Cinco amigos, animados por el juez del pueblo, se disfrazan como halcones y luchan contra una banda de asaltantes.

programme.sub-title: Wicked Fun at the Vauxhall Pleasure Gardens
programme.desc: Popular with the aristocracy and the middle classes; the Vauxhall Pleasure Gardens are 12 acres of woods and gravel walks on the South Bank of the Thames; the stories of social interaction, pleasure, and danger that abound around this public place.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour
programme.sub-title: Taking the Dead Man's Path to Tyburn Tree
programme.desc: The trial and execution of Jack Sheppard in 1724; Jack's story highlights the public display of state power and the nature of public life in 18th-century London; Jack Sheppard meets an ignominious end; the haves and the have-nots of London's past.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.sub-title: Why Dracula Frightens and Seduces Us
programme.desc: Exploring the roots of the vampire in European folklore that precedes Dracula's creation.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula's role in Western culture.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.desc: Examining the literary and historical sources influencing Stoker's creation of Dracula.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.desc: Exploring stoker's choice for an elegant and sophisticated vampire count.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.desc: Romantic evolution of modern vampires.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.sub-title: Why Dracula and Disease Travel Together
programme.desc: The impact of vampire narratives on real-world discourse of disease.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula's role in the Victorian sub-genre - Analyzing how themes of foreign invasion shape the gothic narrative and its modern adaptations.

programme.title: The Real History of Dracula
programme.desc: Evolution of vampire-fighting methods.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: A trip to Mérida, the capital of the Yucatán; visiting a factory hosting the revival of an industry that made the Yucatán rich more than 100 years ago; the mansions lining Mérida's Paseo de Mont; shopping for the perfect hammock and guayabera shirt.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Traveling to Izamal, the "yellow city" named after the Maya sky god; touring the city's history, including a walk through the Convent of St. Anthony of Padua; venturing to Chichen Itza; looking at the achievements of Maya architecture.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: A trip to Valladolid and Ek' Balam, two places in the Yucatan; the first offers travelers a chance to see a traditional agave distillery and an all-female troop of competitive horseback riders; the second is the ruins of what was once a Maya capital.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Accompanying Dr. Barnhart as he writes his name in Maya hieroglyphs; talking to howler monkeys; plunging into a geological cathedral; a journey to Tihosuco, home to an episode of an oppressed people fighting for their independence.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Exploring the history and culture of Mayapan and its surrounding region; the destruction of sacred Maya codices during public acts of faith held by the Spanish friar Diego de Landa; sampling dishes of grilled pork and ground pumpkin seeds.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Discovering what makes Uxmal a marvel of Maya urban planning; Dr. Barnhart explores archeological features, including the Pyramid of the Dwarf, the Palace of the Governors and the Nunnery Quadrangle; exploring the Loltun Caves.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Looking at Kabah, where one will find over 200 faces of Chaac the rain god and a rare example of literate public art; visiting Becal, famous for producing some of the best jipijapas in the Yucatán; taking a trip to the Celestun biosphere.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Labna is an architectural wonder crowned by three buildings, which are the Palacio, the El Mirador pyramid and the Labna Arch; decoding the cultural messages in these famous works; traveling back to Merida.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Learning about the Dead Sea Scrolls and their discovery; ancient Judaism and early Christianity prior to the scrolls; the uncovering of the scrolls and how they alter one's understanding of every aspect of the historical period of their creation.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Diving into a tale of excitement and adventure and discovering more about how scholars gain access to the first seven scrolls discovered at Qumran; what they find when they begin to translate the extraordinary initial discoveries.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.sub-title: Opening and Reading the First Scroll
programme.desc: Immersing into the text of the scrolls, starting with the scroll known as the Community Rule or Manual of Discipline; the important text that gives one the first insight into the community and theology of the scrolls' creators and guardians.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.sub-title: The Historical Backdrop of Ancient Judaism
programme.desc: Examining history prior to the scrolls, beginning with the biblical period and moving to the Maccabean revolt; the arrival of the Romans; King Herod's reign; the life of Jesus; the Zealot revolt; the destruction of Jerusalem and the fall of Masada.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Jewish Sects
programme.desc: Jewish sectarianism in late antiquity; focusing on the Sadducees, Pharisees, Essenes and Zealots through Josephus, the Jewish philosopher Philo and the authors of the New Testament books; the later rabbis; Roman polymath Pliny the Elder.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.sub-title: The Dead Sea Site of the Qumran Sect
programme.desc: Visiting the isolated region of Qumran's caves; learning how archeological excavations of a nearby ruin help scholars form the most accepted hypothesis of who writes the scrolls and why the scrolls are deposited in the caves.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.sub-title: The Emergence of the Rabbinic System
programme.desc: Stepping forward in time and examining some later rabbinic texts from the third century; the rise of the rabbinical tradition; vital perspectives on the composition of the Dead Sea Scrolls.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.sub-title: A Dead Sea Scroll from Medieval Cairo
programme.desc: Two copies of the Damascus Document are discovered in a Cairo synagogue in the 1890s; although the copies are medieval, the texts are believed to be ancient, a conclusion later confirmed when fragments of the same texts are found at Qumran.
